title: Project Aquarius document said to be real

tellings.quote: I've seen the Aquarius document. Alonzo said it was real. People have been saying for years that that was fabricated by Bill Moore uh and Rick Dodie and it turns out no, Alonzo said those guys had nothing to do with anything.

related.note: Both are about the Aquarius document that names MJ-12. Bishop calls it a fake given to Bennewitz, while Davis's source says it was real and that Moore and Doty had nothing to do with it, so only one account can be right.

plain: A briefing document known as the Project Aquarius document, long said to have been faked by two men named Bill Moore and Rick Doty, is in fact real, according to a man named Alonzo McDonald. Eric W. Davis, a scientist who has worked for the Pentagon, tells Michels he has seen the document himself and that McDonald told him Moore and Doty "had nothing to do with anything". If true, it would mean a paper many dismissed as forged is a genuine government briefing.
